items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: I worked in Chicago with him. I worked at 58th and State in Chicago with my brother.

ctx.x: I worked at the Pumpkin with Leo Ede on drums. And myself on... Where'd I play trombone or bass? Trombone I think. I think bass pedal. Bass and sousaphone.
Did you ever work any jobs with Deacon?
My brother? Uh huh. No. I worked in Chicago with him. I worked at 58th and State in Chicago with my brother.
